richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Hapur

c: Many of the regular walkers in a town park like Hapur's are older residents, and an outdoor gym here should start with them in mind. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to municipal parks, housing colonies, schools and temple grounds in Hapur, on the eastern edge of the National Capital Region. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,150 km away, and travel to western Uttar Pradesh by road.

Gentle machines move only as fast as the user does, which makes them comfortable for people with stiff knees or shoulders. They also run on body weight, with no electricity and no settings to change. Our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes them on grouted or self-standing bases. Send us the size of the park and photos of the walking path. We will suggest a set of machines and send a layout drawing showing the clear space around each one.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines are easiest for senior citizens?
items.a: Tai Chi wheels, seated twisters, the Leg Lift Post and the Fun Cycle are good choices. They are low impact and the user controls the speed of every movement.

items.q: Do the machines need any power supply?
items.a: No. Every Fun Fitness machine works on the user's own body weight and movement. There is nothing to switch on and no weight plates to change.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Hapur?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from our Vasai factory and install with our own team or a dealer in north India. Send us the site size and photos to begin.
